title: Upload Document in Files
description: Complete the upload document workflow in the Files module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with general access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Files module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for upload document are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Files module from the main navigation.
Locate the upload document entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for upload document.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Upload Document completes without warnings or blockers.

Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during upload document.

recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun upload document.
Confirm role permissions for general and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun upload document?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm upload document is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
